claims.claim: Fabrinet's record FY2026 growth supports a causal role as outsourced precision manufacturing capacity connecting optical/electronic technology programs to deployable communications and compute infrastructure; the structural value depends on customers continuing to externalize complex manufacturing rather than vertically integrating.

The principal successor bottlenecks are customer/program concentration, skilled/capacity execution and utilization if AI/optical deployment timing slows; these limit inference from growth to durable bottleneck control.

causalEdges: advanced optical/electronic designs -> outsourced precision manufacturing -> communications/AI infrastructure deployment -> bandwidth and compute availability
customer outsourcing preference -> Fabrinet utilization -> manufacturing scale economics
customer vertical integration or program delay -| Fabrinet utilization and bottleneck control

risks.risk: Customer or program concentration can make otherwise valuable manufacturing capability fragile to a small number of schedule changes.

unknowns.unknown: Customer concentration, program mix and forward capacity utilization remain unquantified in the reused source.

claims.claim: The available primary evidence demonstrates exceptional current growth but does not establish diversified customer dependence, durable pricing power or immunity from a capacity cycle; those are bounded uncertainties rather than present blockers.
A direct falsifier of a durable bottleneck thesis would be material customer insourcing, persistent utilization deterioration, or concentration-driven program losses that outpace new-program wins.

risks.risk: Growth concentration and outsourced-manufacturing cyclicality may inflate confidence if record revenue is treated as proof of durable control.
Vertical integration by major customers is a credible substitute to outsourced manufacturing for selected programs.

unknowns.unknown: No reused evidence quantifies top-customer exposure, dilution/financing stress, or capacity utilization; Alpha/filing work can address financial quantification without blocking Beta closure.
